observations: 2026-08-11: the Jaguars' first unofficial 2026 depth chart lists RB1 as 'Bhayshul Tuten OR Chris Rodriguez Jr.' — an explicit co-starter designation. Full order behind them: LeQuint Allen Jr., Ameer Abdullah, DeeJay Dallas, J'Mari Taylor (jaguars.com).

Rodriguez missed the entire offseason program with a foot injury and opened camp in individual drills only; on his first padded-practice carry (Monday ~2026-08-03) he 'weaved through a rushing lane before unleashing his momentum upon a defensive back' (Yahoo, 08-04). SI's John Shipley: Rodriguez stood out in team drills on the first padded day 'because of the way he was able to churn out yards after contact'.
HC Liam Coen (team-official): Rodriguez 'did kind of what you think he's going to do'.
Room context: Travis Etienne departed to New Orleans in the offseason; the Tuten-vs-Rodriguez battle is for the lead role in his absence.
inferences: Directional mechanism (pre-baseline, preserved as inference): Rodriguez's return applies real opportunity pressure to the Jacksonville backfield split, including a power/goal-line profile contrast with Tuten's speed.
The goal-line-back projection is outlet analysis, not observed deployment, and is preserved only as inference.
